features.description: Gemini Apps brainstorm ideas, summarize complex topics, and draft outlines, emails, and posts; usable signed-out, with history saved to a Google Account.
Chat via text, voice, photos, or camera; summarize Gmail/Drive; generate images on the fly; 'Hey Google' on Android; plan with Maps and Flights.
gemini.google.com in any browser on computer.
Native Gemini apps for Mac (Apple Silicon, macOS 15+) and Windows.
Streamlined Gemini for Android Go devices, replacing Assistant Go.
Choose among Gemini models for quick everyday answers or in-depth analysis; some models only come with Google AI plans.
Access to specific Gemini models, thinking levels, and task features varies by plan; top tiers include models built to reason through long-horizon problems.
Gemini shows working/thinking status while generating; not documented on a dedicated help page (unverified).
Natural, free-flowing voice conversations with Gemini that you can interrupt mid-sentence.
Audio descriptions of what your camera sees, inside Gemini Live.
Use Live with Gemini in the Chrome browser.
Tap Listen to hear responses read aloud; choose Gemini's voice in the mobile app and it applies across Gemini Apps.
Regenerate the most recent response or ask Gemini to adjust length, simplify language, or change tone; switch between versions.
Editing a previously sent prompt is reported by users but not documented in the help center (unverified).
Create a public link; anyone with it can read, reshare, and continue the chat on their own.
Export responses from Gemini Apps.
Attach documents, spreadsheets, notebooks, photos, and videos for answers, summaries, and insights.
Dedicated focused spaces that remember your sources, instructions, and ongoing discussions; sync with Gemini Notebook.
Create or edit docs, apps, slides, or code side-by-side with Gemini; convert results into Audio Overviews or quizzes.
Custom versions of Gemini with their own instructions and files; shareable by link.
Starting November 2026 Gems transition to skills: reusable, stackable custom instructions invoked with / (soon @) that Gemini can also apply automatically.
Multi-step Deep Research for complex topics.
Schedule recurring actions - daily news digest, weekly inspiration, monthly suggestions - prepared in the background for your chosen delivery time.
Schedules and tasks deliver prepared content in-app; push notifications are reported by users but not documented (unverified).
Assign Gemini tasks that automate complex workflows using Connected Apps, skills, chats, signed-in sites, and location, with schedules for ongoing tasks.
Proactive personalized updates summarizing Connected Apps like Gmail and Calendar plus your chats.
Connect apps like Gmail, Google Calendar, YouTube Music, Spotify, or Photos so Gemini can pull in content and take actions with your permission.
Connect and manage custom apps, including importing a GitHub repo to ask about in the web app.
Personalization built on memory of past chats, connected Google apps, and your preferences/instructions.
Gemini learns from your past chats to personalize responses (18+, personal accounts, activity on).
Nano Banana models create and refine images with accurate text rendering and subject consistency.
Generate videos with Gemini Apps.
Generate music with Gemini Apps.
Generate Audio Overviews in Gemini Apps.
Create and use an avatar in Gemini Apps.
Quizzes, flashcards, practice tests, storybooks, and other study tools.
Find, pin, rename, and delete chats (History must be on).
Manage and delete your Gemini Apps history and activity.
Download your Gemini Apps data.
Import your chats from other AI platforms into Gemini Apps.
Control your Android device and apps with Gemini.
Control smart home devices from the Gemini mobile app.
Make calls and send messages, including via WhatsApp, with the Gemini app.
Share your screen and chat with Gemini about what's on it.
Chat with Gemini in your car.
Use Gemini in Google Messages.
Get answers from the Gemini web app while browsing in Chrome.
Make purchases and payments with Gemini Apps.
Guide your child's Gemini Apps experience.
Use Dark theme in Gemini Apps.
Change Gemini's language.
